before.text: A second way that stress can show up is in our emotions! By giving us big feelings! Like REALLY big.
Like a heavy feeling or not wanting to practice, even when a big show is coming.
The nervous stress makes you want to avoid getting ready, like you’re pushing the big day away to give yourself more time.
But actually, you’re just making yourself more nervous and stressed.
When I feel stressed like this, I get cranky and mean to people around me. This might happen to you too.
This is emotional stress! It’s totally normal, and we can learn how to handle it.
